verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, since buyers compare hosted and self-hostable CRMs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Follow Up Boss can be self-hosted: every item describes the hosted SaaS, its pricing and trial, and its REST API and webhooks. The GitHub repository holds API usage examples, not deployable product code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
